findings.highlight: I'm taking the last train of the day right now
findings.evidenceJa: 今、俺が乗ってきた終電
findings.explanation: Haruki points out the last train he just arrived on after leaving the station. The translation says he is currently taking it, contradicting both his location and the audible train departing behind him.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、あれ？
今、俺が乗ってきた終電」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, that? I'm taking the last train of the day right now."

findings.highlight: Kaiousha has agreed to hire you
findings.evidenceJa: 開桜社、入れそうなんだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna excitedly says it looks as though Haruki may be able to get into Kaiousha. No hiring decision has been made; the very next line corrects her because he has only been promised a recommendation.
findings.japanese:
「え…本当なの？
開桜社、入れそうなんだ！」
findings.todokanai: "Eh… Really? So Kaiousha has agreed to hire you!"

findings.highlight: This is a really nonsensical conversation
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にとりとめもないことを話した
findings.explanation: Haruki says they talked about genuinely rambling, inconsequential things. Calling the conversation nonsensical makes it irrational rather than tenderly aimless and distorts the point of their prolonged small talk.
findings.japanese: 本当にとりとめもないことを話した。
findings.todokanai: This is a really nonsensical conversation.

findings.highlight: there shouldn't be any issues if you're using it to motivate yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 頭がでかくて何が悪い。支える体だってあることをアピールするまで
findings.explanation: Haruki answers Setsuna's 頭でっかち joke by literalizing the oversized head and boasting that he has the body to support it, then clarifying he does not chiefly mean physical stamina. The translation abandons the head/body mechanism and replaces it with an unrelated claim about motivation.
findings.japanese:
「頭がでかくて何が悪い。
支える体だってあることをアピールするまで。
…主に体力面とは違う意味で」
findings.todokanai: "What's wrong with getting full of myself? At least, there shouldn't be any issues if you're using it to motivate yourself. …Specifically, in a way that's different from keeping yourself physically driven."

findings.highlight: it's already about time this got brought into the conversation
findings.evidenceJa: もう、そうゆうことまで話せるようになっちゃったんだ
findings.explanation: Chiaki realizes Haruki and Setsuna have reconciled enough that they can now talk even about Chiaki's spring deadline. The passive English merely says the subject has entered the conversation, losing who can finally speak to whom.
findings.japanese:
「そっか…そっか…
もう、そうゆうことまで話せるようになっちゃったんだ」
findings.todokanai: "I see… I see… so it's already about time this got brought into the conversation…"

findings.highlight: This was always meant to be
findings.evidenceJa: 昔からそうなんだろ
findings.explanation: Haruki says Chiaki has always been this way, leading into Takeya's warning that she discards everything after a performance. The translation turns a claim about her longstanding behavior into a claim of fate or inevitability.
findings.japanese: 「昔からそうなんだろ…」
findings.todokanai: "This was always meant to be, no…?"

findings.highlight: I can grasp the feelings of all of them
findings.evidenceJa: 全部が全部、そのキャラクターになりきることができた
findings.explanation: Chiaki says she could become every character completely, whether adapted, original, or modeled on someone. The translation narrows this to grasping their feelings, weakening the acting claim that sets up Setsuna as the unique failure.
findings.japanese:
「今まで、たくさんの他人を演じてきた。
原作つきも、オリジナルも、誰かをモデルにしたときも、
全部が全部、そのキャラクターになりきることができた」
findings.todokanai: "I've played many different roles up until now. From other people's characters, original characters, to modeled characters. I can grasp the feelings of all of them."

findings.highlight: I can understand her, but I couldn't be like her
findings.evidenceJa: 理解はできたけど、共感はできなかった
findings.explanation: Chiaki's explicit distinction is that she could understand Setsuna but could not empathize with her. 'Couldn't be like her' replaces empathy with resemblance and breaks the conceptual opposition pursued through the next scene.
findings.japanese:
「そこはあたしの負け…
結局、本物の小木曽雪菜にはなれなかった。
理解はできたけど、共感はできなかった」
findings.todokanai: "This is my loss… In the end, I still couldn't become Ogiso Setsuna. I can understand her, but I couldn't be like her."

findings.highlight: what I just said could've started a space-war
findings.evidenceJa: 宇宙戦争を仕掛けようなんて訳じゃないんだけどな。本当は
findings.explanation: Haruki says that, despite attacking Chiaki's interpretation, he is not actually trying to start an interplanetary war. The translation says his words could have started one, replacing denied intention with possible consequence.
findings.japanese:
だからって…
宇宙戦争を仕掛けようなんて訳じゃないんだけどな。
本当は。
findings.todokanai: That's why… what I just said could've started a space-war.

findings.highlight: That's just what you want to believe
findings.evidenceJa: 『思う』ばっかりだね
findings.explanation: Chiaki pointedly observes that Haruki keeps saying 'I think,' challenging the uncertainty in his repeated phrasing. The translation instead accuses him of wishful thinking, changing the specific rhetorical jab.
findings.japanese: 「『思う』ばっかりだね」
findings.todokanai: "That's just what you want to believe."

findings.highlight: the same fear has been ingrained within me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺と同じ恐怖が植えつけられてるんだと『思う』
findings.explanation: Haruki says that because Setsuna underwent the same experience he did, he thinks the same fear has been ingrained in Setsuna. The translation assigns that fear to Haruki, defeating his new recognition that Setsuna shares it.
findings.japanese:
「俺と同じ体験をしてきた雪菜だからさ、
俺と同じ恐怖が植えつけられてるんだと『思う』」
findings.todokanai: "I've shared the same experience Setsuna's had, and that's why I feel that the same fear has been ingrained within me."

findings.highlight: It's not something physical, it's a psychological fear
findings.evidenceJa: かけがえのない人を、物理的にだけじゃなく、精神的に失うことの怖さ
findings.explanation: Haruki asks whether Chiaki knows the fear of losing an irreplaceable person not only physically but emotionally. The translation contrasts physical and psychological fear instead, deleting the compounded loss and much of the accusation directed at Chiaki.
findings.japanese:
「お前、知らないだろ？
かけがえのない人を、物理的にだけじゃなく、
精神的に失うことの怖さってさ」
findings.todokanai: "You still don't understand? It's not something physical, it's a psychological fear of losing someone important."

findings.highlight: she's actually attentively listening to me talking about my pain
findings.evidenceJa: あからさまに痛いこと聞かれてる
findings.explanation: Haruki says Chiaki is openly asking him painful questions. The translation turns her active probing into compassionate, attentive listening while he volunteers his pain.
findings.japanese:
別にベッドの中で騙されてる訳じゃないのに。
それどころか、あからさまに痛いこと聞かれてるのに。
findings.todokanai: It's not like I was tricked into talking about it on the bed. On the contrary, she's actually attentively listening to me talking about my pain.

findings.highlight: not even let me hold her anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きしめてもくれないこんな奴に
findings.explanation: Haruki laments confiding in someone who will no longer hold him. The translation says Chiaki will not let Haruki hold her, reversing who withholds the embrace.
findings.japanese:
もう、慰めてもくれない、肯定してもくれない、
…抱きしめてもくれないこんな奴に。
findings.todokanai: Why would I tell this to someone who won't comfort me, accept me… and not even let me hold her anymore?

findings.highlight: She's abandoned her acting without knowing it
findings.evidenceJa: 気づかせない演技をかなぐり捨て、はっきりした悪意をわざと剥き出しにさせる
findings.explanation: Chiaki deliberately throws aside the act designed to conceal itself and intentionally lays her malice bare. The translation says she drops the act unknowingly, reversing the calculation Haruki sees in her applause.
findings.japanese:
気づかせない演技をかなぐり捨て、
はっきりした悪意をわざと剥き出しにさせる。
findings.todokanai: She's abandoned her acting without knowing it, laying her spite bare with the gesture.

findings.highlight: you don't have to answer it
findings.evidenceJa: 答え方ってものがあるんじゃない
findings.explanation: Chiaki says that even so, there are ways one ought to answer such a question—she objects to how bluntly Haruki answered. The translation says he need not answer at all.
findings.japanese:
「それにしてもさぁ、
答え方ってものがあるんじゃない？」
findings.todokanai: "Even if that's the case, you don't have to answer it, you know?"

findings.highlight: the sharp, sober remark I mumbled meant for both myself and her
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯の強がりか、醒めきった捨て台詞か、そんな、自分でもどちらとも取れる台詞
findings.explanation: Haruki cannot tell whether his own line is desperate bravado or a thoroughly disillusioned parting shot. The translation changes this two-way self-interpretation into a remark supposedly meant for both people.
findings.japanese:
でも俺は、精一杯の強がりか、醒めきった捨て台詞か、
そんな、自分でもどちらとも取れる台詞を呟く。
findings.todokanai: But I do my best to steel my senses, the sharp, sober remark I mumbled meant for both myself and her.

findings.highlight: I've said something that I really didn't want to say
findings.evidenceJa: 本気で言って欲しくなかった言葉
findings.explanation: These are words Haruki truly did not want Chiaki to say, although he expected she inevitably would. The translation makes Haruki himself the person who has just said the unwanted words.
findings.japanese:
本気で言って欲しくなかった言葉だけど、
絶対にこいつは言うだろうなぁと覚悟だけはしてた。
findings.todokanai: I've said something that I really didn't want to say, and I can only prepare for the inevitable response she'll have.

findings.highlight: the real Chiaki disapproves of my denial of her
findings.evidenceJa: 演技の千晶を拒絶した俺が、本音の千晶に否定されていく
findings.explanation: Haruki rejected the performed Chiaki and now feels the candid Chiaki rejecting or negating him. The translation instead makes her object to his denial of her, reversing who is being rejected.
findings.japanese:
演技の千晶を拒絶した俺が、
本音の千晶に否定されていく。
findings.todokanai: As I reject Chiaki's masquerade, the real Chiaki disapproves of my denial of her.

findings.highlight: release everything inside my mouth
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと中に出してもらうからね
findings.explanation: Chiaki says that if her mouth makes him hard, his penalty will be to come inside her; the conventional unqualified 中に出す denotes internal ejaculation, not ejaculation into the mouth. The translation adds an oral location absent from and at odds with the sexual proposition.
findings.japanese:
「そんかわり、あたしの口でおっきくなったら
あんたの負け。そんときはペナルティとして、
ちゃんと中に出してもらうからね？」
findings.todokanai: "In exchange, if you happen to get hard when I put it in my mouth, you lose. And as a penalty, I'll have you release everything inside my mouth, alright?"
